title: Recursively Trained Diffusion Models: Limiting Collapse Distribution and Spectral Characterization
abstract: arXiv:2606.13796v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Recursive training of generative models on their own outputs can lead to model collapse, a compounding drift away from the true data distribution. Existing theoretical works bound finite-round error accumulation in the context of diffusion models, but two questions remain open:~what distribution does the recursion converge to, and how fast? We answer both, isolating a mechanism distinct from imperfect learning: even with perfect score estimation and exact sampling, the early stopping of the reverse diffusion (required for numerical stability) drives a progressive drift away from the data distribution. We prove that this recursion converges geometrically to a unique limiting distribution, which admits a closed-form characterization as an infinite mixture of increasingly Gaussian-smoothed versions of the data distribution. A Hermite spectral decomposition of this limit reveals that recursive training acts as a low-pass filter: hi

translated_title: 递归训练的扩散模型：极限坍缩分布与谱特征刻画
translated_abstract: 在生成模型自身的输出上进行递归训练可能导致模型坍缩（model collapse），即不断累积地偏离真实数据分布。现有理论工作针对扩散模型给出了有限轮次误差累积的界，但仍有两个问题悬而未决：递归最终会收敛到什么分布？收敛速度有多快？我们对这两个问题均给出了解答，并分离出一种不同于“学习不完美”的机制：即使评分估计完全精确、采样也完全精确，反向扩散过程的提前停止（数值稳定性所必需的）也会驱动分布逐渐偏离真实数据分布。我们证明该递归以几何速率收敛到一个唯一的极限分布，该分布具有闭式刻画——它是数据分布经过越来越强的高斯平滑后的版本的无限混合。对该极限分布的 Hermite 谱分解揭示出，递归训练起到了低通滤波器的作用：高频……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文证明，即使在评分估计与采样完全精确的理想条件下，反向扩散的提前停止也会使递归自训练的扩散模型以几何速率收敛到一个唯一的极限分布（即数据分布的 increasingly 高斯平滑版本的无限混合），且该过程如同低通滤波器般滤除高频信息，从而完全刻画了模型坍缩的极限分布与收敛速度。
en_tdlr: Even with perfect score estimation and exact sampling, recursively trained diffusion models converge geometrically to a unique limiting distribution—an infinite mixture of increasingly Gaussian-smoothed versions of the data—driven by early stopping of reverse diffusion and acting as a low-pass filter.
